items.summary: Hey HN, Toby from Nari Labs here.We've been working on making OSS speech models super-fast. Last year, we built Dia, the first OSS text-to-speech model capable of doing natural dialogue. Since then, so many more great speech models have been released to the public.But the market is still dominated by closed source models.
items.full_text: Hey HN, Toby from Nari Labs here.We've been working on making OSS speech models super-fast. Last year, we built Dia, the first OSS text-to-speech model capable of doing natural dialogue. Since then, so many more great speech models have been released to the public.But the market is still dominated by closed source models. We think that's an inference problem.
